findings.summary: The diff artifact named as job 2's own deliverable is empty (0 bytes) even though journal.jsonl line 70 records a `diffed` event for job 2 at this exact path, timestamped after the `verified` event. Reading this file in isolation shows no diff at all; the only way to recover job 2's actual changes is to read the four target files directly out of the still-present build worktree at .claude/worktrees/agent-a3035507bf70a9115 (base caf518d), which I did to complete this review. The journal's own record of having written the diff does not match what is on disk, which is exactly the shape of performative evidence: a step that claims to have produced an artifact without the artifact backing it up. Anyone who trusts job-2.diff as the reviewable surface, as this review's brief instructed, gets nothing.
